text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
And put up the new curtains... and we're 
done!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Waaah, so pretty, so clean! 
That turned out 120 miles of pure 
perfection!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Moreover... I can no longer "hear" 
anything from this room. 
............I'd say we're making excellent 
progress.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Next... Gentile-san, Gran-san, please take 
the hallway. 
Blast-san and Dia-san... could you please 
clean the balcony?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Okaaay! ...Wait, you're already gone!? 
Gentile-senpai, wait for meee!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...Blast-san, let's head over too. 
Let's do our best gathering the fallen 
leaves♪

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
All right, Dia! Let's sweep all the leaves 
into the middle! 
Hyah, hyah, hyaaah~~!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my, Blast-san! 
You're certainly full of energy.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Well, the hall's cleaned up, and the 
balcony's almost done too! 
We're just a little bit away from 
finishing everything!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Once we're done, let's take a happy photo 
together! With our 
"joy" and "happiness," we'll make everyone 
smile!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, you're right. 
To make that happen—............Eek!?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
The leaves we gathered are blowing away in 
the wind... Let's bag them up quickly! 
............Oh?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...What's this...? 
A red... ca... rd......?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Thud...)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...—Nnnn... 
...Where is this? A chapel—?

text_block_list.name: Ceremony Hall Ghost
text_block_list.text:
No. No, no, no. —Stop it. 
I was the one who loved him first.

text_block_list.name: Ceremony Hall Ghost
text_block_list.text:
Why are you the one beside him? Don't take 
him. No. It hurts. It's unfair. 
Don't take him away from me! Why are YOU 
with him...!

text_block_list.name: Ceremony Hall Ghost
text_block_list.text: —I don't want to see this anymore.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ............—What was that just now—...

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: —...Dia, did you see it too?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It was a dream... rejecting someone's 
wedding.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I see... That was a residual memory 
projected by the ghost. 
...—Simply put, a grudge itself.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
And you "saw" something as well, 
Blast-san?

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: Yeah. But mine was different from Dia's—

text_block_list.name: Bride Ghost
text_block_list.text:
—...I was so happy when I was joined with 
him. 
I was so joyful, I wanted the whole world 
to witness our wedding.

text_block_list.name: Bride Ghost
text_block_list.text:
But then I realized... how my sister felt. 
I called off the wedding at once. 
And yet, I'm still—here. ...I'm still 
trapped here.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, what if we held a wedding for this 
bride? 
Ghosts can't pass on if they still have 
lingering regrets, right?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Wait, does this bride have something 
to do with the ghost that Dia-san saw?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Their cards look so similar! 
If we hold the ceremony, won't the other 
ghost get mad?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Either path will leave lingering 
resentment. 
Yet staying idle will resolve nothing... 
What will you do?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...With the information we've gathered, 
we can prepare to exorcise it...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Yet the two of you... came to consult us 
hoping for a different way, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes... We want to bring happiness to both 
of them! 
Because—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...Because we understand.
